body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2007') -- <Visual News> Innowell presented its 7-inch UMPC ''UREN'' during CES 2007. While it can serve as navigation system in a car, users can also carry the compact mobile pc around at ordinary times.
The UREN features Window XP Home Edition OS, 7-inch WVGA TFT LCD,1.8-inch 30GB HDD, and 256 internal memory. It measures 192(W)*120.5(H)*25(D)mm at 695g and runs on lithium-ion battery.
< AVING Special Report Team for 2007 International CES: Editor & Publisher, Brain Park, Min Choi, Kevin Choi, Joshua Shim, Rose Kim, Niki Hwang, Alliyah Seo, Jun Lee, Daniel Sirh >
